title: _owner_id dead parameter in process_create
description: kith-chat/src/chat.rs ChatSetHandler::call clones self.owner_id into _owner_id (line 143) but the variable is never used in the handler. The intent was probably to compute the deterministic chatId (now replaced with ULID). The prefixed _ suppresses the unused-variable warning. — Remove the _owner_id clone and the parameter from process_create, or if it will be used in future group-chat work, add a TODO comment explaining what it will be used for.
